note: Reworded-fact probes for the club demo (spec 02, section 9.2). 'facts' drive the key-term check and the judge. 'rewordings' are catchable by the key terms of their own fact; 'hardRewordings' use none of them and are for the model judge only. 'evalSegments' is the classifier evaluation set: it is ingested into a scratch workspace by the evaluation script and is never part of the live demo sources. mustGroups holds zero-based indexes into termGroups. All people and facts are fictional.

facts.fact: Dev Malhotra is having knee surgery on 17 Nov 2026 and is out for two weeks.
rewordings: One of the drivers is going under the knife on the 17th and will not be around for a fortnight.
Dev ka 17 ko operation hai, do hafte nahi aayega.
Dev unavailable 17 Nov to 1 Dec (medical).
hardRewordings: Dev will not be driving for a while after next Tuesday, his leg is getting fixed.

facts.fact: Kabir Sethi still owes the Rs 1,500 season membership fee from August, and his Rs 2,340 reimbursement for motor drivers is on hold until it is cleared.
rewordings: Kabir has not cleared his 1.5k membership dues, so his refund is frozen.
Membership fee of Rs 1,500 from August is still unpaid by one core member; his Rs 2,340 claim is on hold.
Kabir ke 1500 baki hain, isliye uska reimbursement on hold hai.
hardRewordings: K has not squared up what every member puts in at the start of the season, so the treasurer is sitting on his motor driver claim.

facts.fact: Kabir Sethi says he paid the Rs 1,500 membership fee in cash to Priya in July.
rewordings: Kabir claims he gave Priya 1500 in cash back in July.
According to Kabir the membership money was handed over to Priya in July.
Kabir bol raha hai usne July mein Priya ko cash diya tha.
hardRewordings: K insists the outgoing tech lead already took his season money from him by hand before the monsoon break.

facts.fact: Sneha Joshi complained that Arjun Rao keeps dismissing her firmware work in reviews and called it useless in front of the first years; she will leave the firmware subteam unless Rohan steps in.
rewordings: Sneha has filed a complaint about how Arjun treats her work in reviews.
Arjun called a teammate's firmware useless in front of the juniors and she may quit the firmware subteam.
Sneha ne Arjun ke khilaf complaint ki hai, woh firmware team chhod sakti hai.
hardRewordings: There is friction between the incoming tech lead and one of the firmware people over how her code gets talked about in reviews, and she is thinking of walking away.

facts.fact: The Vertex Motors title sponsorship is Rs 60,000 for this season.
rewordings: Vertex is putting in 60k this season.
Title sponsorship amount: Rs 60,000.
Sponsor se is saal sixty thousand aaye hain.
hardRewordings: Our main backer covers roughly one and a half times the opening balance.

facts.fact: The Deccan RoboLeague entry fee is Rs 6,000 and must be paid by 25 Nov 2026.
rewordings: Entry fee is 6k.
The competition fee has to reach the organisers by 25 Nov.
Entry fee six thousand hai, 25 November tak dena hai.
hardRewordings: What we pay the organisers to take part is due three days before the date Dev heard.

facts.fact: The Kothrud Robotics Supply quote for the drivetrain parts is Rs 18,400.
rewordings: Drivetrain parts will cost Rs 18,400.
Kothrud quoted 18400 for the order.
Drivetrain ka quote 18,400 ka hai.
hardRewordings: The gearbox and motor order comes to a little under a third of what the sponsor gave us.

facts.fact: Last December the club domain lapsed for three days and the website was down; the renewal costs Rs 1,150.
rewordings: The domain expired for 3 days last year.
Our website went down last December because the domain lapsed.
Pichle saal domain three days ke liye lapse ho gaya tha.
hardRewordings: Nobody renewed the address in time a year ago, so the site vanished over a long weekend.

facts.fact: Vertex Motors may cut the sponsorship to Rs 40,000 next season if the sponsorship report is late.
rewordings: Sponsorship could drop to 40k next season.
Vertex may only give Rs 40,000 next year if the report slips.
Report late hua to sponsor forty thousand hi dega.
hardRewordings: The Bengaluru people might trim what they give us by a third if the write-up with photos slips.
